scientific_status_basis.the_recorded_technical_problem: The independent consultant's impedance calculation: CSF 1.52 MRayl; brain tissue 1.58 (Z ratio 1.039) and fibrous debris ~1.63 (Z ratio 1.072) — both BELOW the 1.1 kill-threshold ratio (reflection coefficients only 1.9-3.5 %). The DOMINANT clinical obstruction types (tissue ingrowth, fibrous debris, protein aggregation) are acoustically near-invisible to this system; air (ratio 3800) and calcification (5.13) are detectable but are MINORITY obstruction types. Verdict class: 'kill condition appears to be triggered by the physical properties of the most common obstruction types'.
scientific_status_basis.the_counter_record: The reconciliation downgraded the consultant verdict to PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: 'Impedance values are correct. Kill-condition conclusion requires the dossier's actual detection model, not just impedance ratio. Reframe as feasibility risk requiring empirical test.' The V2 mutation discloses: 'HIGH FEASIBILITY RISK ... Kill condition NOT confirmed — detectability depends on frequency, transducer geometry, signal processing, and clutter, not just impedance ratio. A frequency-dependent phantom experiment is required.'
scientific_status_basis.net_state: CONTESTED-BUT-UNREFUTED: the broad obstruction-detection thesis is at HIGH FEASIBILITY RISK with the kill condition NOT empirically confirmed; the resolvable experiment is recorded (frequency-dependent tissue-phantom acoustic impedance contrast measurement, consultant-estimated ~$8K/12 weeks class, 'likely negative for tissue'). No cemetery entry exists (the engine never killed it); the CEO retired it on business grounds with the caveats preserved verbatim.
scientific_status_basis.threshold_provenance_note: The 1.1 kill-threshold ratio is a consultant/CEO-stated figure, not an engine-recorded number (Constitution Art. XXVII: it carries consultant_stated provenance, never silent promotion to measured fact)
